name: cavemio-create-password
title: Create password
description: A password step with a chameleon: the stronger the password, the better Hide blends in, until only his eye is left.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The field is a real new-password input labelled Password; the eye is a toggle button with aria-pressed. Each rule is a list item that says done or not yet, and every check placed or taken back is announced from a status region.
- Hide is decoration (aria-hidden). He is an illustration shipped inside hide-art.ts as two WebP data URIs (43KB of images, 59KB as text), so the install is complete with nothing to put in public/; his pupil, tongue, blush, colour change and hop are drawn in code over it.
- One frame loop outside React writes his styles and sleeps when he’s still; his breathing is a compositor animation. The tongue is drawn in an overlay over the block and costs no React renders.
- The stage is the lit --primary surface engraved with fine scales; he blends into whatever colour your theme gives it, light or dark. Tongue, pupil, blush and check colours are --hide-* variables you can override. No drop shadows, glow or blur.
- With reduced motion there is no tongue, hop or breathing: checks appear in place and his colour changes in place.
- Built from Password input, Status button and Text morph, which the CLI installs with it. No animation library.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: – · Called with the password once every rule is met. Keep it; throw an Error to show its message.

props.name: checkBreaches
props.description: – · How many known breaches the password is in (0 if none). Asked 450ms after typing stops once the rules are met, and again on Continue if needed; a newer password aborts the older ask. If it fails, Continue still works.

props.name: rules
props.description: PASSWORD_RULES · { id, label, test(password) }. Defaults: 8+ characters, a number, a capital letter, a symbol.

props.name: username
props.description: – · The account’s email or username, in a hidden field so password managers save the pair.

props.name: title / description / submitLabel
props.description: "Create a password" / "The stronger it is, the harder Hide is to find." / "Continue" · The heading, the line under it and the button.

props.name: name
props.description: "Hide" · What the chameleon is called in his lines.

features.title: Rules that react
features.description: Each rule met gets its check from Hide’s tongue; lose one and he takes it back.

features.title: Strength you can see
features.description: He blends further into the stage with every rule, until only his eye is left.

features.title: Breach check
features.description: checkBreaches runs once the rules are met, after a pause in the typing; a breached password turns him red and blocks Continue.

features.title: Your rules
features.description: Pass any rules as { id, label, test }; the defaults are length, a number, a capital and a symbol.

features.title: Password managers
features.description: A new-password field with the account’s username beside it, so the pair is offered and saved.

features.title: Submit with states
features.description: Continue → Checking → Saving → Password set, or the server’s message under the field.

states.title: spotted
states.description: Hide sits on his branch in full colour, his pupil following the caret (or the pointer between keystrokes); the line above reads “Hide is easy to spot”. He breathes and blinks now and then.

states.title: catch
states.description: A rule met: he glances at its circle and his tongue shoots out (150ms), touches it, and the check pops in and draws itself as the tongue comes back (210ms). Several at once go one after another, faster.

states.title: blend
states.description: Each check moves a front of colour change further from tail to snout (about 600ms): behind it only his shading is left, in the stage’s colour, with a brighter band at the front as it passes.

states.title: gone
states.description: Every rule met: only his eye is left in the scales and the line asks “Where did Hide go?”. Continue lights up.

states.title: take back
states.description: A rule lost: his tongue fetches the check, he swallows it with a little bob and the colour comes back a step.

states.title: exposed
states.description: Show password: the colour floods back at once, his eye squeezes shut and his cheek flushes; hiding it lets him blend in again.

states.title: startle
states.description: Wiping the field once two or more rules were met: the checks fall away, he jumps with a tiny pupil and says “Hey! I was hiding.”

states.title: breached
states.description: checkBreaches returns more than 0: he turns red, the field says how many breaches the password was seen in, and Continue stays off.

states.title: saved
states.description: Continue → Checking → Saving → Password set with a drawn check, and he winks; if onSubmit throws, the button shakes into Try again and the message shows under the field.
